exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Historical Silent Storm softly matte PAINTED equipment UV diffuse COLOR bitmap, faithful subtle high-resolution sourcepaint.

Image1 is the EXACT ENTIRE original native64x64 storedRGB source, solely whole NEAREST8x512 opaqueRGB enlargement. Preserve the COMPLETE edge-to-edge normalizedUV/native fields/count/phase/scale/palette/shadows and original local weak strengths. Original fullsource alpha is separately restored, brightness only ONE global numerical scalar. No physical object render or interpretation of vague pixels as extra mechanisms/hardware.

Same DARK MATTE GRAYBLUE source paint wholeatlas. Keep TWO original dark-centered grayblue ringpaintfields: ONE small upperleft,ONE larger lowerleft, every original irregular curved tonal line and darkcore gap; do not create physical shinywire/rings/cables/hardware. In large lowerleft sourcefield EXACT FOUR interior tonal crests lie at nativex2/4/7/9 on nativey42–43; original clipped outerboundary x0 is separate. Preserve EXACT4 measured interior crests and IRREGULAR2/3/2pixel phase/pitch, never regularize or add rings. Keep original top-left vertical pale/dark paintstripes, central narrow grayblue vertical shadefield and complete rightside original vertical grayblue shades; every tiny weak source highlight stays same strength/location. Native black throughout is original opaque paint/shadow, not cutout emptiness. Do not turn faint bluegray wash into new white rods/chrome bevels/coarse knurl/etchedgrooves or additional physical mechanisms. Preserve original softly painted boundary/material/detail scale; not a photo.

Actual source wholeRGBA extrema are [[0, 198], [0, 195], [0, 214], [255, 255]]. Preserve original local light hierarchy and weak pigments. Very subtle fine PAINT only, no photograin/pores/stipple/mosaic/coarse brushcells/rust/weave/shine/sharperwhite outlines. No new bolts/rivets/straps/buttons/parts or new text/marks. Do not brighten shadow fields or create pale plates.

Output ONLY the SAME COMPLETE full opaqueRGB source square, same normalizedUV. No crop/zoom/padding/whitespace/frame/cutout/autobbox/repack/fitting/sourceRGB patches/newcount/shape/material. Entire originalalpha/defaultpadding restored downstream; no invented alpha.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST8x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
